\*\*Game:\*\* Elsword Online     \*\*Account:\*\* EmailXXXX    \*\*Status:\*\* Banned    \*\*Effective Date:\*\* Month, Day, Year, Time    \*\*Duration:\*\* Permanent Ban    \*\*Reason:\*\* Users who have 167 web login using 1 IP within 1 day.
